findings.title: Opaque PilotToolPermit is copyable and has no specified atomic consumption gate
findings.recommendation: Route Registry invocation through a one-shot PermitExecutor/closure or Registry wrapper that consumes permit atomically before handler entry; prevent adapter access to a bypass Registry.Call.

implementation_gates: Specify and implement a non-bypassable, atomically consumed one-shot permit boundary before Registry handler entry.
Test copied/reused/mismatched permits are rejected before handler execution.
Implement pinned-connection rollback_proven typed outcome without promoting uncertainty to rollback proof.
Verify tagged and default Go build graphs exclude/include the intended adapter and harness packages.
